media_folder.title: Media folder
media_folder.description: One folder for your downloads and your library, shared by every app here, so a finished download is moved instantly instead of copied. Create one, or pick one you have.

requests.title: Requests with Jellyseerr
requests.description: The people you share Jellyfin with can ask for films and shows from their phone.

subtitles.title: Subtitles with Bazarr
subtitles.description: Finds subtitles in your languages for everything in the library.

watch_anywhere.title: Watch from anywhere
watch_anywhere.description: Jellyfin and Jellyseerr get a YoLab address you can open from any network. Off, they are reachable at home only.

tailscale.title: Watch over Tailscale
tailscale.description: Jellyfin and Jellyseerr also join your tailnet, so your own devices reach them privately.

manage_anywhere.title: Manage downloads from anywhere
manage_anywhere.description: Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr and the download client get YoLab addresses too. Off, you manage them at home only.

existing_client.title: Which one
existing_client.description: It joins this group as it is: point it at the media folder in its own settings.

tailscale_auth_key.description: Create a reusable one in the Tailscale admin console under Settings, Keys: Jellyfin and Jellyseerr both use it once to sign in.
